versions.changelog: v1.1: PDCA closed-loop feedback system for sustaining hospitality. 5 metrics, closed-loop anti-patterns, 2 new principles (#13 Closed Loop, #14 Accountability Without Bureaucracy), 10 feedback checkpoints. Source: Guidara + PDCA synthesis.
v1.0: Universal skill based on Will Guidara's book. 7 Laws + 12 Principles + Design Checklist + Anti-patterns + Scoring Framework. For AI assistants, UI/UX, copy, product review, onboarding.
